name: Ursin
source: The first person to have encountered Elcia upon her first visit to the Middle Ages. An energetic young boy whom surprisingly enough, isn't your typical spoiled brat for a rich kid. He's actually down to earth and can be a little too trusting when it comes to strangers. He's quite proud of his heritage and adores his father, Pedoe, greatly.
